productArea.name: Notifications and watching
productArea.scope: Inspect unread, read, and pinned notifications, change their read state, and search, filter, sort, or manage subscribed and watched repositories. Notification links check navigation to issues and pull requests without exploring those destination features.

entryPoints.directions: Open Notifications from the bell and use its read, unread, and pinned views and actions. Generate a disposable issue or pull request event if notifications are empty.
Choose Subscriptions to inspect subscribed issues and pull requests and their notification controls.
Choose Watching to manage watched repositories and their search, filters, and sorting.
